scenes.headline: How four 1B adapters specialize a frozen 744B model
scenes.sub: Mind Lab's Macaron-V1, and a Mixture of LoRA routed once per request
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Saffron! Macaron-V1 is an agent model built on a base it never retrains. Here's how four small adapters do all the specializing.

scenes.text: Freeze a strong open base, attach four tiny LoRA specialists, and let the chat adapter route each request to the one that fits.
scenes.say: The idea: freeze a strong open base, attach four tiny specialists, and let the chat adapter route each request to the one that fits.

steps.say: Start with GLM-5.2, a strong open base of seven hundred and forty-four billion parameters, and freeze it.
Attach four LoRA adapters of one billion each: chat, agent, coding and generative UI. About half a percent of the whole artifact.
The chat adapter doubles as the router. It reads each new request once, and hands it to the specialist that fits.

steps.note: handoffs pass a concise summary, not shared state
steps.say: That specialist keeps the turn, reasoning and tool calls included. When it finishes, it passes a short summary on, not shared state.

left.title: Mixture of Experts
items: Routes every token, at every MoE layer
Experts are built in pretraining, inseparable
left.say: A mixture of experts routes every token at every layer, and its experts are baked in during pretraining.

right.title: Mixture of LoRA
items: Four swappable files on someone else's base
right.say: Mixture of LoRA routes once per request, between swappable files. When the base improves, you re-fit adapters instead of retraining.

scenes.title: Points gained over the frozen base
scenes.note: most rows gain about 3 to 6; UI4ABench is Mind Lab's own
scenes.say: Against the frozen base, most rows gain three to six points, and two sit inside noise. Generative UI jumps twenty point seven, on Mind Lab's own benchmark.

scenes.text: Treat a frontier open-weight model as infrastructure, and put the specialization in small, swappable files.

recap: Four 1B LoRA adapters, one per skill
The chat adapter routes once per request
scenes.say: To recap: a frozen base, four small specialists, and a chat adapter that routes each request once.
